Miss Fiesta Latina 2026

When: 2026-09-05 (Friday)
Time: 6:00pm
Venue: The Signal
Address: 21 Choo Choo Ave, Chattanooga, TN 37402
Entrance Fee: Tickets required
Event Website
#the-signal#music

Miss Fiesta Latina 2026 celebrates beauty, talent, and culture from Chattanooga’s Latino community at The Signal on September 5. The night features candidates competing across multiple categories in a formal pageant setting. This is a community-anchored event that brings together families and supporters from across the region. Doors at 6pm.
